formulas.securityFilter: AND(ISNOTBLANK(USEREMAIL()), IN([Ref Partner], SELECT(Partners[Row ID], LOWER(TRIM([Login Email])) = LOWER(TRIM(USEREMAIL())))))
formulas.selectedSlice: AND([Ref Cash Account] = ANY(Cash Statement Context[Ref Cash Account]), [Statement Date] = ANY(Cash Statement Context[Statement Date]))
formulas.dateInitial: MAX(Cash Account Daily Summary Recent[Statement Date])
formulas.dateValidIf: AND([_THIS] >= MIN(Cash Account Daily Summary Recent[Statement Date]), [_THIS] <= MAX(Cash Account Daily Summary Recent[Statement Date]))
formulas.userLanguage: IF(ANY(SELECT(Partners[Language Preference], LOWER(TRIM([Login Email])) = LOWER(TRIM(USEREMAIL())))) = "ไทย", "ไทย", "English")
formulas.transaction: IF([User Language]="ไทย", SWITCH([Transaction Type Code],"LOAN_PAYMENT","รับชำระเงินกู้","FIRST_DAY_PAYMENT","รับชำระวันแรก","LOAN_DISBURSEMENT","จ่ายเงินกู้","BUSINESS_EXPENSE","ค่าใช้จ่ายธุรกิจ","REFERRAL_REBATE","เงินคืนค่าแนะนำลูกค้า","PARTNER_SETTLEMENT","ชำระให้หุ้นส่วน","ACCOUNT_TRANSFER","โอนระหว่างบัญชี","CASH_TRANSFER","โอนเงิน","EXPENSE_REIMBURSEMENT","คืนค่าใช้จ่าย","OPENING_BALANCE","ยอดยกมา","MANUAL_CORRECTION","ปรับปรุงยอด","รายการอื่น"), SWITCH([Transaction Type Code],"LOAN_PAYMENT","Loan Payment","FIRST_DAY_PAYMENT","First-day Payment","LOAN_DISBURSEMENT","Loan Disbursement","BUSINESS_EXPENSE","Business Expense","REFERRAL_REBATE","Referral Rebate","PARTNER_SETTLEMENT","Partner Settlement","ACCOUNT_TRANSFER","Account Transfer","CASH_TRANSFER","Cash Transfer","EXPENSE_REIMBURSEMENT","Expense Reimbursement","OPENING_BALANCE","Opening Balance","MANUAL_CORRECTION","Manual Correction","Other"))
formulas.counterparty: SWITCH([Counterparty Kind], "BORROWER", IF(AND([User Language] <> "ไทย", ISNOTBLANK([Ref Borrower].[Description])), [Ref Borrower].[Description], [Ref Borrower].[Borrower Name]), "ACCOUNT", [Ref Other Cash Account].[Account Label], "PARTNER", [Ref Partner].[Partner Name], "ADJUSTMENT", IF([User Language]="ไทย", "ปรับปรุงยอด", "Adjustment"), [Counterparty Text])
formulas.balanceStatus: IF([Is Initialized], "", IF(ANY(SELECT(Partners[Language Preference], LOWER(TRIM([Login Email])) = LOWER(TRIM(USEREMAIL())))) = "ไทย", "ยังไม่ได้กำหนดยอดตั้งต้น", "Balance not initialized"))
